scenes.text: Did you know there is a fifty-mile strip of land in America where you could technically get away with the perfect crime?
It is located inside Yellowstone National Park, and it is known as the Zone of Death because of a bizarre loophole in the US Constitution.
The Constitution requires a jury from the exact state and district of the crime, but this Idaho strip has zero residents to form one.
Without a jury, a trial cannot legally happen, so would you ever dare to visit this creepy place?
